Name: (CP) Alya's Seasons In The Woods Furniture Set
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[size=2]Oh, well... This is basically a Content Patcher version of one of my Alternative texture furniture sets, so if you prefer AT you might  want to check out [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14941][size=2]this[/size][/url][size=2]. However, there are some changes in these sets. [/size]

[b][size=2]About this mod:[/size]
[/b][size=2]
[u]The colors of most furnishings are automatically changed based on the season[/u].  [u]
[/u]If you want only a specific color, you might want to check the AT version, because I'm a complete novice at this kind of modding and i couldn't manage to add that option here, sorry :)
[u]It has its own furniture catalog, you can purchase it at the Carpenter's shop.[/u] (The  default price is 5000, but you can change it using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ or simply by editing config.json file). 
[u]Adds 70+ furniture items, mostly vanilla sprites recolors with "Seasons in the woods" theme
[/u]Есть перевод на русский язык (also it has a russian translation)[/size][u]
[/u][size=2]
Own catalog means vanilla furniture (or another CP furniture set, if you already have one) won't be affected by these texures as CP mods usially do. Thanks for this option to - Sophiesalacia with the [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628][size=2]Calcifer[/size][/url][size=2] mod. So Calcifer is absolutely necessary. 
[/size]
[b][size=2]How to use this mod:[/size][/b]
[size=2]Download this mod and all requirements - [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url].[/size]
[size=2]Extract it and drop into your mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods)[/size]

[size=1]All sprites in this mod are vanilla sprites recolored by me or drawn by me.[/size]

[b][size=2]Have fun with decorating![/size][/b]
